mechanics.claim: Riven can activate the ability three times before it goes on cooldown, with a static 0.3125s cooldown between casts, each cast dealing the same per-cast damage.
mechanics.quote: '''Riven''' can activate ''Broken Wings'' three times before the ability goes on cooldown, with a {{fd|0.3125}}-second {{tt|static cooldown|Unaffected by ability haste}} between casts

mechanics.claim: If Riven does not recast within 4 seconds of the previous cast, the ability goes on cooldown.
mechanics.quote: If '''Riven''' does not recast the ability within 4 seconds of the previous cast, it goes on cooldown.

mechanics.claim: Each cast resets Riven's basic attack timer and orders her to basic attack the target of Broken Wings if there are any.
mechanics.quote: {{tip|Basic attack reset|resetting}} her basic attack timer, and ordering her to basic attack the target of ''Broken Wings'' if there are any

mechanics.claim: Each cast counts as a single ability activation for on-cast effects such as Spellblade.
mechanics.quote: Each cast counts as a single ability activation for the purposes of on-cast effects such as {{tip|Spellblade}} and triggering {{ais|Force Pulse|Kassadin}} passive.

mechanics.claim: The third cast has a larger effect radius and briefly knocks back enemies hit.
mechanics.quote: '''Riven''' mimics the first cast's dash, but now slams her sword in a larger circle, briefly {{tip|airborne|knocking back}} enemies hit as well.
